cover_letter.greeting: Dear Origis Energy Capital Markets Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Capital Markets Associate role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Origis builds and owns solar and storage at scale, and the capital markets team is where those projects get financed. Energy and project finance is the area I most want to build a career in, so this team is a natural fit for what I'm working toward.

The closest work I've done is an MBA project modeling a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio. I built project and portfolio models covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures, and recommended a phased green loan + ABS approach that reduced sponsor equity by $11.1M in the model and lifted levered IRR from 8.58% to 9.79%. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%.

My project finance experience comes from coursework, not live financings, so I'd be learning tax equity and facility administration on the job. What I can bring from day one is careful modeling, comfort with debt metrics like DSCR, and steady follow-through on the details that lenders and investors ask about. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
